title: The Messiah Factory · Why read this book?
description: When rewards for securing allegiance arrive sooner than rewards for being correct, groups may select for voices that stabilize belief over those that improve it; the book proposes separated roles, staged evaluation and 'incomplete tribes' so cooperation can survive correction.

readerInvitation.reasonToExist: The Messiah Factory asks why the power to persuade keeps passing for understanding. Its suspicion is that becoming audible may reward fixed answers over revisable thought. Yet the book also refuses the flattering story of the ignored genius.
readerInvitation.readerPromise: When rewards for securing allegiance arrive sooner than rewards for being correct, groups may select for voices that stabilize belief over those that improve it; the book proposes separated roles, staged evaluation and 'incomplete tribes' so cooperation can survive correction.
readerInvitation.audienceFit: readers interested in leadership, charisma, online attention, group belief, institutional design and how communities can admit error
readerInvitation.closingInvitation: Begin with “Who Gets Heard,” and ask which contest your trusted voices won.
readerOutcomes: It first separates attention, credibility, authority, performance and welfare into different contests.
